verdict.rationale: The only CLI evidence is the smithery-cli README, and it shows consumer-side commands: registry search, adding a connection, and finding or calling tools. No CLI commands for authenticating, building or staging, or pushing a server are documented, and publishing is described as a web flow where you enter a public HTTPS URL. The CLI is real but adjacent to this story, since nothing shows it driving the publish-and-deploy workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the publish-and-deploy workflow from an official CLI — authenticate, stage or build a server, push it, and install it into agents
